stages.note: creation method (photo/paint/bake): Kari to record if this ships

stages.method: Original regolith background kept on every map; the source chevron tread band was located (dark-lug detection), patched with neighbouring ground texture, and a new procedural tread pattern stamped along a periodic meander (tiles along V like the source). All 8 maps re-derived consistently: height delta -> color shading, roughness, normal (gradient re-injection), alpha coverage; mask passed through unchanged. Seeds 20/30/40/50/60/70/80. 07_perseverance mimics the Mars 2020 wheel imprint: 48 grousers/wheel -> ~34 mm pitch (26 px), thin bars with a gentle S-curve across the tread. 08_curiosity mimics the MSL imprint: 24 shallow-chevron grousers per ~1.56 m revolution plus the JPL Morse odometry cutouts (.--- .--. .-..) as raised tabs between grousers, one repeat per revolution (period = canvas/7 so it tiles). Rover patterns are from public mission imagery knowledge; no source images used. 09_hakkapeliitta (seed 90) is a STYLISED studded-winter-tyre imprint (directional V-blocks, siping, zigzag center groove, tiling stud dents at passenger-tyre width) drawn from generic winter-tyre knowledge — NOT a reproduction of Nokian Tyres tread geometry, and no manufacturer material was used. TRADEMARK NOTE: the folder/material name references Nokian's brand for internal identification only; if this asset ships publicly, do not use the Hakkapeliitta name in public-facing content without Kari's license review.

TWIN (_2x) versions of all nine (incl. the original chevron as Rover_trace_decal_2x, generated 2026-07-30, --twins flag): two wheel lines of one vehicle at gauge 0.55x canvas width sharing one meander; pattern layout identical per wheel; alpha bell rebuilt as twin coverage; the original's twin extracts the real tread band along its detected meander and re-composites it twice onto the patched background.
